comments: All 8 acceptance criteria approved as proposed. Recorded on the reviewer's instruction given in chat and transcribed by the orchestrator; the decision is the reviewer's, the transcription is not an agent approval. Note for downstream stages: ETA-351 contains no acceptance criteria in Jira, so all 8 criteria are PROPOSED_BY_REQUIREMENT_ANALYSIS readings of the story description rather than business-authored criteria. The six ambiguities AMB-ETA-351-001 through AMB-ETA-351-006 were NOT resolved at this gate and remain REVIEW_REQUIRED; they are deferred to PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION, where the real login page can answer the observable ones (field set, selection mechanism, failure-response difference). Any ambiguity that the application cannot answer - in particular the intended scope of secret handling (AMB-004) and whether permission-limited behaviour is in scope (AMB-006) - must return to a human before it is asserted as a business rule. Test plan scope should therefore stay within what these criteria literally assert and must not harden any unresolved ambiguity into an expectation.

itemDecisions.comment: Page offers a way to declare the sign-in kind before details are entered. Selection mechanism unresolved (AMB-ETA-351-002).
Both sign-in kinds are offered and distinguishable. Business Entity Login behaviour remains out of scope.
Choosing organization sign-in changes which details are asked for. Exact field set unresolved (AMB-ETA-351-001) and must not be assumed.
Password is not readable on screen. Scope limited to on-screen concealment; any wider secret-handling obligation is unresolved (AMB-ETA-351-004).
Correct details reach the Home page. Criterion ends at arrival; permission-limited behaviour unresolved (AMB-ETA-351-006).
Wrong details are refused and reported. No message wording may be asserted (AMB-ETA-351-003).
Missing details are refused and reported. Which details are mandatory is unresolved (AMB-ETA-351-005).
The two failure responses are distinguishable. Asserted as a difference only, never as specific text (AMB-ETA-351-003).
